name: Ellery Himeyuri
source:
A member of "Milky Holmes".
The main protagonist of the Tantei Opera Milky Holmes 2 PSP game. Formerly a police officer who suddenly gained Toys, she was put in charge of Milky Holmes. Her Toys allow her to activate other people's Toys by force.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tantei_Opera_Milky_Holmes#Milky_Holmes]Wikipedia[/url].]

A member of "Milky Holmes".
The main protagonist of the Tantei Opera Milky Holmes 2 PSP game. Formerly a police officer who suddenly gained Toys, she was put in charge of Milky Holmes. Her Toys allow her to activate other people's Toys by force.
